# Captured tool check

Before recommending a shell-tool workflow, use the Organization Analysis CLI to cite at least two distinct real captured Turns. Keep Seeded Sessions illustrative, preserve unavailable and inferred evidence labels, and state that repeated observation does not establish causation.
